qualification.reason: The document is a Request for Proposals (RFP) issued by the City of Providence Board of Contract and Supply for the Hope High School Boiler Demolition and Abatement project. It includes a clear procurement title, issuing department, submission instructions, deadlines, bid package requirements, and scope of work, all indicating a competitive solicitation.

quotes.quote: Item Description:  Hope High School- Boiler Demolition and Abatement

Bids may be submitted up to 2:15 P.M. on the above meeting date at the Department of the City Clerk. Room 311, City Hall. 25 Dorrance Street, Providence. At 2:15 P.M. all bids will be publicly opened and read at the Board of Contract Meeting in Conference Room 305, on the 3rd floor of City Hall.

The objective is to safely and legally perform the hazardous materials abatement and selective demolition/removal of the existing boiler systems at Hope High School located at 324 Hope Street, Providence, RI 02906.
